answer_text: To diagnose slow Internet, run a ping and traceroute to compare latency when traffic goes through Cato versus bypassing Cato to identify sub-optimal routing. If you're on Wi‑Fi, a weak signal can cause slow performance; a signal of -75 dBm or worse may trigger a poor Wi‑Fi notification. Also verify that the Socket link speeds are full duplex and meet the configured bandwidth, since a link-speed mismatch can throttle throughput; Network Analytics can help you compare last-mile versus site performance. If the issue is due to connectivity to the Cato Cloud, Recovery via Internet can temporarily bypass the Cato Cloud to restore Internet traffic while you investigate.
